mainEntity.name: What is the best crypto PR agency for a Web3 startup?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most Web3 and crypto founders, the best option is a fractional senior operator rather than a traditional crypto PR agency. The practical reason: at an agency, a junior account exec pitches your story to journalists they have never met. With a fractional operator, the person who built the relationship with that CoinDesk reporter is the one pitching your announcement. Shilika Jain runs crypto PR directly for $5K–$12K/month and has placed 50+ founders in Forbes, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block and Blockworks.

mainEntity.name: How much does a crypto PR agency cost in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-service crypto PR agencies typically charge $15K–$45K per month, which covers a multi-person account team. A fractional senior operator delivers the same senior-level scope for $5K–$12K per month, with no account-team overhead. A time-bounded launch sprint, covering four to eight weeks of intensive work around a mainnet, TGE or raise, runs $15K–$40K.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you actually get a crypto project into?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream business and tech: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Regional crypto: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP and CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA), plus Gulf-region business press for MENA-facing projects. Every placement depends on a genuine news hook and a well-positioned story.

mainEntity.name: What does the process and timeline look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: The engagement starts with a teardown: a read of your press footprint, category position and the one story worth telling. That shapes a narrative brief. From there, outreach to journalists and KOLs starts, with any embargo strategy built around your key announcement date. A typical launch cycle runs four to eight weeks from briefing to publication. Ongoing retainers add sustained coverage, AI-citation tracking and APAC localisation on top.

Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your press footprint and where there is a story to work with. Or book a 30-minute call directly and we work through it live. No deck required, no agency intro call with four people on the Zoom.
